title: Source
description: A retrieved scene span: where it is in which asset version, how well it matched, and the text it was found by. Enough to cite a timestamp, open the scene record (scene_set_version, scene_indices) and evaluate relevance by asset version and time span.

chunk_version.description: Data version of the chunk behind the span.

scene_set_version.description: Data version of the scene set; with a scene index it names a scene record.

score.description: Similarity to the question as the index scores it; higher is closer.

text.description: The text the span was found by.

sources.description: Source systems holding the asset version, for display names and deep links.
